crossRefs.note: to deliver you from the strange woman, even from the foreigner who flatters with her words,
For the lips of an adulteress drip honey. Her mouth is smoother than oil,
For why should you, my son, be captivated with an adulteress? Why embrace the bosom of another?

translations.web: All these had taken foreign wives; and some of them had wives by whom they had children.
translations.bsb: All these men had married foreign women, and some of them had children by these wives.
translations.kjv: All these had taken strange wives: and some of them had wives by whom they had children.
translations.asv: All these had taken foreign wives; and some of them had wives by whom they had children.
